findings.message: Contraction "doesn't": write the words in full.
"being": not an approved form of BE (only be, is, are, was, were). Rewrite without it.
"being recomputed": passive voice, or a past participle used as an adjective (permitted, 3.3)? Confirm. In procedures, use the imperative.
"-ing" word "robust-looking": permitted only if it is a technical noun or a modifier in one ("wiring diagram"). Confirm, else rewrite.
"been": not an approved form of BE (only be, is, are, was, were). Rewrite without it.
27 words (descriptive, max 25): "Compute the deadline once, store it, and utilize it for every attempt; also consider ad..."
Semicolon: "Compute the deadline once, store it, and utilize it for every attempt; also consider ad..."
"-ing" verb form "adding": not permitted. Rewrite with a simple tense ("when you do", not "when doing").
